hook.name: GlueHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 buyback-and-burn hook that executes a pump (buyback) after every swap on a configured pool: it spends a secondary-currency pot to buy the pool's designated main token, then delivers it to a recipient (address(0) = burn via Glue Protocol). Additionally supports an optional auto-compounding hook-held LP program with configurable fee-split rules.
